content:
# At some point during the site tweaks, I managed to create a regression with /reader. I don't know how or when, but things just stopped working properly and only a few feeds would update. I'm not even sure that I made database specific changes around the time things stopped working. 🤷‍♂️

I initially thought it might be a specific feed causing a problem so backed up my OPML and started deleting them one-by-one.

No dice.

I ended up doing a full refactor before re-adding all the feeds. I still don't know exactly what happened, but at least it's working.
